assertion: An event exists, described as "Spider-Man dominates box office".
judge_quote: ‘Spider-Man’ continues to dominate box office, passing $2 billion globally
evidence_cited: 'Spider-Man' continues to dominate box office, passing $2 billion globally || The Sony Pictures release added another $70 million from theaters in the U.S. and Canada, bringing its domestic total to a staggering $785.8 million, making it the fourth-biggest domestic release ever. || With $118.7 million from overseas markets, it surpassed $2 billion globally, only the eighth movie ever to achieve that landmark (not accounting for inflation) and the second-fastest to do so.
